power_balance.case: temperature-BH sample with identical geometry and material, dedicated zero supplied coil resistance
power_balance.coil_loss_W: 0.5 * real(Zcoil) * abs(I)^2; must be exactly zero in this case
power_balance.body_heat_W: sum of accepted face-integrated heat outputs, not heat densities
requirements: Use accepted port voltage and prescribed current without reconstructing the reaction row from cfg.eddy or operator_impedance_map
Pair voltage, heat and current from the same accepted electromagnetic update; omit initialization/reset placeholders
Require finite strictly positive dissipated body heat
Apply the gate to every accepted update, not only a final average

reactive_sign.case: separate nonmagnetic passive conductor: constant mu=mu0, positive resistivity, no remanence and no nonlinear BH table
reactive_sign.expected_sign: negative: induced eddy currents reduce coil inductance for this nonmagnetic conductor
requirements: Require nonzero finite current and finite passive surface impedance
Confirm the sign independently with the air-domain HCurl FEM reaction voltage, without native BEM assembly
Require both BEM refinement levels to satisfy the sign and the preregistered reaction-impedance convergence gate
Do not apply this sign rule to the magnetic temperature-BH sample: permeability can increase inductance
If the chosen publishable case produces a reaction below the floor, report insufficient signal rather than a pass

artifact_requirements: Final clean source commit and installed wheel SHA256
Actual loaded MEX path and SHA256 matching the installed wheel
Validation source hashes and preregistered plan hash
Per-update voltage, current, face heat, power error and reaction impedance in JSON
Same artifact used by native and Simulink/Toolkit qualification
limitations: Power balance alone is necessary but does not prove every transpose entry correct
Same-boundary-law FEM comparison does not validate the nonlinear bulk approximation
No execution or release acceptance is claimed by this plan
